hazards.title: Unprotected trench without shoring
hazards.description: Two workers are inside a deep, narrow trench with near-vertical unsupported walls and no visible trench box, shoring, sloping or benching, creating a serious cave-in risk.

hazards.title: Spoil pile at trench edge
hazards.description: A large pile of excavated soil and rocks on the right side is placed directly at the trench lip, adding surcharge load and risk of material rolling onto workers below.

hazards.title: Excavator operating near trench
hazards.description: An excavator at the upper right is positioned close to the trench and spoil pile while workers are in the excavation, posing struck-by and wall-collapse risks.

hazards.title: Workers at unprotected trench edge
hazards.description: Workers on the left stand at the crumbling, unbarricaded trench edge, including one lowering a pipe into the trench, risking a fall into the excavation or edge collapse.
hazards.category: Working at Heights and Fall Protection

hazards.title: No visible trench access ladder
hazards.description: No ladder or ramp is visible in the trench for the workers inside, limiting safe entry and emergency egress.

hazards.title: No barricades along trench
hazards.description: The long open trench lacks visible barricades or warning barriers along its edges, despite workers and traffic in the surrounding area.

hazards.title: Pipe lowered over workers below
hazards.description: A worker on the left edge is lowering a pipe into the trench while other workers are working in the trench below, creating a struck-by risk from falling material.

hazards.title: Stacked pipes near trench edge
hazards.description: A stack of large gray pipes on the left is stored near the trench edge with only a wooden stake as restraint, posing a risk of rolling or adding load near the excavation.

hazards.title: Loose debris and rubble at edge
hazards.description: Loose gravel, rocks and broken material along the left trench edge create tripping hazards and can fall onto workers in the trench.
